interface.longDescription: Discover cup, tumbler, and bottle colorways with Cupboard. Browse by brand, model, color, retailer, or release date, or share a photo to compare it with catalog references. Review the closest suggestions and choose your match, then explore the full catalog in The Cupboard app. Photo matches are suggestions, not proof of authenticity. No live prices, stock checks, or purchasing. No Cupboard sign-in is required. Shared photos are processed by Cupboard’s hosted service.
